excerpt: ASA (Advertising Standards Authority, autorité britannique de régulation de la publicité), décision du 20/10/2021 (Alpro (UK) Ltd, plainte retenue, en anglais) : « because we considered it was not clear what the basis of the claim “GOOD FOR THE PLANET” was, we concluded the ad was misleading and breached the Code » ; « The ad must not appear again in the form complained about » ; « We told Alpro (UK) Ltd to ensure that the basis of environmental claims was clear »

ASA (Advertising Standards Authority, autorité britannique de régulation de la publicité), décision du 26/01/2022 (Oatly UK Ltd, plainte retenue sur quatre des cinq points, en anglais) : « Five issues were investigated, of which four were Upheld and one was Not upheld » ; « We concluded that, because the claim would be understood by consumers as based on equivalent and full life cycle analyses when that was not the case, ads (c) and (d) were misleading » ; « We told Oatly UK Ltd to ensure that the basis of any environmental claim was made clear »

ASA (Advertising Standards Authority, autorité britannique de régulation de la publicité), décision du 07/06/2023 (Shell UK Ltd, plainte retenue sur un des deux points, en anglais) : « Because the ads did not include such information, we concluded that they omitted material information and were likely to mislead » ; « We told Shell UK Ltd to ensure that their future ads featuring environmental claims did not mislead by exaggerating or, omitting material information about, the proportion of their business activities that were comprised of lower carbon activities »
